# Source: Statue of Young Dionysos

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Statue of Young Dionysos
- **Artist / culture:** Hellenistic or Roman; Eastern Mediterranean
- **Date:** 100 BCE-100 CE
- **Style:** hellenistic
- **Classification:** sculpture
- **Department:** Arts of Greece, Rome, and Byzantium
- **AIC artwork ID:** 217295
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/217295
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/3f3ba9a2-24e0-435f-64e7-31114121b3be/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Theater

## Extracted source palette

`#A8A8A8, #585858, #888888, #484838, #787868, #282818, #080808`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#25251D`
- `surface`: `#3E3E37`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#A8A8A8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#282818`
- `surface_variant`: `#3E3E37`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#60605A`
- `error`: `#A8A8A8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `14.51:1`, surface `10.13:1`
- Variant contrast: `10.13:1`
- Control contrast: `8.22:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
